title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on John 9: the man born blind who washed in the pool of Siloam, and what he told the Pharisees.

questions.text: What did the disciples ask Jesus about the man who was blind from birth?
questions.explanation: His disciples asked who had sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind.

answers.text: Whether he could be healed on a Sabbath
Who had sinned, he or his parents
How long he had been begging
Whether he was old enough to answer

questions.text: What reason did Jesus give for the man being born blind?
questions.explanation: Jesus answered that neither the man nor his parents sinned, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

answers.text: Because his parents had sinned
Because he himself had sinned
Because the Sabbath had been broken
That the works of God might be revealed in him

questions.text: What did Jesus put on the blind man's eyes?
questions.explanation: He spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, and anointed the blind man's eyes with the mud.

answers.text: Mud made with saliva
Oil from a flask
A bandage of linen
Ointment of pure nard

questions.text: Where did Jesus tell the man to go and wash?
questions.explanation: Jesus told him to go and wash in the pool of Siloam, and the man went, washed, and came back seeing.

answers.text: In the brook Kidron
In the river Jordan
In the pool of Siloam
In a basin in the temple

questions.text: On what day did Jesus make the mud and open the man's eyes?
questions.explanation: The text says it was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

answers.text: At the Passover
At the Feast of the Dedication
On the Preparation Day
On a Sabbath

questions.text: What did the healed man say about Jesus when the Pharisees asked him again?
questions.explanation: When they asked him again what he said about the one who opened his eyes, he answered that he is a prophet.

answers.text: He is a sinner
He is a prophet
He is the Christ
He is a disciple of Moses

questions.text: How did the man's parents answer when asked how their son could now see?
questions.explanation: His parents said that they did not know how he now sees, that he is of age, and that he should be asked himself.

answers.text: Jesus opened his eyes
He was never blind
He is of age; ask him
He was healed in the temple

questions.text: What had the Jews agreed would happen to anyone who confessed Jesus as Christ?
questions.explanation: The parents were afraid because the Jews had already agreed that anyone who confessed him as Christ would be put out of the synagogue.

answers.text: He would be put out of the synagogue
He would be stoned at once
He would be taken to Pilate
He would pay a fine to the priests

questions.text: What was the one thing the man said he knew for certain?
questions.explanation: He said he did not know whether Jesus is a sinner, but that one thing he knew: though he was blind, now he sees.

answers.text: That Jesus is a sinner
That God listens to everyone
That his parents had sinned
That though he was blind, now he sees

questions.text: What did the man say had never been heard of since the world began?
questions.explanation: He said that since the world began it had never been heard that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

answers.text: That a sinner ever kept the Sabbath law
That a man born blind was ever given sight
That God had spoken to Moses in person
That a prophet ever came out of Galilee
